1. Commit and push this file to your repository
2. Optional: If you want coverage reporting to Codecov:
  - Sign up at https://codecov.io
  - Add CODECOV_TOKEN as a repository secret in GitHub Settings
  - Otherwise, remove the codecov steps (they won't break if the token is missing)
3. The workflow will run on:
  - Every push to main branch
  - Every pull request targeting main
  - Manual trigger from GitHub Actions tab

You can view the workflow execution in the Actions tab of your GitHub repository once you push this file!
